title: Read and check capture bytes
responsibility: Reads a recorded capture through the desktop connection and independently checks its hash.

inputs.name: artifactBytes.bridge
inputs.description: A connection with an optional artifact reader. A connection without that operation is refused.

inputs.name: artifactBytes.query
inputs.description: The exact capture request, including its binding and expected SHA-256 hash. Passed unchanged to the artifact reader.

outputs.name: unreadArtifact
outputs.description: The message used when the connection cannot read recorded bytes.

outputs.name: damagedArtifact
outputs.description: The message used when returned bytes do not match the requested recorded hash.

outputs.name: artifactBytes
outputs.description: A promise for copied bytes, the reader’s media type and the independently calculated SHA-256 hash. The bytes must match the requested hash, regardless of the hash claimed by the answer.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects if artifact reading is unavailable or the bytes have a different hash. Backend and hashing failures propagate.
